title: A recording opens on a sharp first frame
goal: When a recording opens in the editor, the picture at the start is drawn blurred, like a small thumbnail stretched up, and stays that way until the playhead moves. It is the first thing anybody sees of their recording.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-25 while building the video guides: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/tutorial-cut-a-recording-down-walk.json (probe, Next defaults, Screen Recording granted, screen unlocked). 1-a-clip-on-v1-sc.png at 0:00, after a 1s wait: the Ready card and the 0 counter are visibly blurred. 6-throw-a-piece-away-sc.png at 0:02 in the same run is sharp. The same blur shows at 0:00 in tutorial-put-a-transition-on-a-cut-walk (two clips, no trim fast lane) and tutorial-add-a-second-clip-walk, so it is not the Trim tool. Suspect the frame fetched at open (EditorState.openRecordingAsDocument -> documentMomentChanged) is a low-resolution one that is never replaced until the moment changes. Captures are copied in queue/audits/2026-09-25-video-guides-cut-sc.png.
acceptance: A recording opened at Next defaults shows its first frame as sharp as any later frame, without the playhead being moved
A walk photographs the picture at 0:00 right after opening and fails if it is blurred
Holds for a recording opened from the Finder and for one a guide opens

log.note: triage 2026-09-25 spot-check: confirmed from the picture in the notes, /tmp/photonz-playtest/tutorial-cut-a-recording-down-walk/1-a-clip-on-v1-sc.png (03:42 today): the Ready card, the 0 and the line under it are visibly blurred at 0:00. Moved p2 -> p1: it is the first thing anybody sees of their recording, at Next defaults, and it is broken rather than unpolished, so it goes ahead of the mock matching work.
